snippet.title: Infernal Eclipse of Ragnarok - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing the Infernal Eclipse of Ragnarok mod pack, an Infernum Mod pack. This mod pack includes many large content mods all with Infernum support, and links them together with its own API and other custom compatibility mods created by the team behind this.

You can experience this mod pack here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3456508757

Learn more about Infernal Eclipse of Ragnarok and other projects related to it by joining their discord server: https://discord.gg/tc5nZdRvaU

If you wish to get updates on the project, updates are posted both to the discord linked above, as well as their YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@InfernalEclipseofRagnarok

Support their development team by joining their Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/InfernalEclipseofRagnarokTeam
